conversation.message: Well, smartphones prioritize portability and communication, while laptops offer more processing power and screen size for complex tasks. The key differences often lie in their primary use cases and capabilities.

conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: user_agent
